required_work: Prove the second activation lane end to end on one wired evidence source, from an admitted product signal to a typed work row, converging on the same authority, receipt, and recovery spine as the request-initiated lane.
objective: Accepted canon composes the flagship with two activation modes: a request-initiated lane and a continuous lane in which a signal from the maintained product produces an automation run, which produces a typed work row, which may escalate. The request-initiated lane is owned by existing records; the continuous lane is owned by none. Wire exactly ONE evidence source through the declared-tools and credential-lease path, admit its first product signal, and carry it to a typed work row that lands in the same inbox, under the same authority evaluation, receipts, and recovery as a request-initiated one. CONTINUOUS_ACTIVATION_LANE_FIRST_ADMITTED_SIGNAL_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: One product signal, admitted through a declared-tool binding under a credential lease, produces a typed work row that is authorised, receipted, and recoverable by exactly the same spine as a request-initiated one — and an unadmitted signal produces nothing at all.
selected_profile: The selected single-node deployment with one wired evidence source: one repository, one declared tool binding, one credential lease, and the work inbox both activation lanes converge on.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

current_implementation_evidence: EXTRACTED OBLIGATION. Verified at 7ee7acc2e: the two-mode composition is accepted canon and is cited by two external-surface records, and no record in the estate owns the continuous lane's implementation. The connector wedge is contract-complete with zero wired sources, so the lane has never been exercised once.
The obligation previously lived only in a planning document outside the estate. It is admitted here so the lane has an owner inside the estate; the plan was reclassified historical in the same pass.
in_scope: Exactly one wired evidence source, bound through the existing declared-tools contract under a credential lease. One is the scope, not a first instalment: the lane is proven or it is not, and breadth adds no proof.
The first admitted product signal carried to a typed work row, with the row's kind, subject reference, and proof reference all present and resolvable.
Convergence evidence: the same authority evaluation, the same receipt family, and the same recovery path as a request-initiated activation, demonstrated side by side rather than asserted.
The escalation edge exercised at least once as OPTIONAL: a work row that escalates, and a work row that correctly does not.
Honest coverage: what this one source can and cannot signal, written down at admission time.
out_of_scope: A second evidence source, a source catalogue, or a general integration surface.
Rebuilding any external system's sensing. The lane consumes an admitted evidence source; it never reimplements one.
The publication effect the escalated work may eventually produce, which is owned by the publication record.
Any claim about continuous operation over time. One admitted signal is one admitted signal.
positive_proof: One admitted product signal produces one typed work row whose authority evaluation, receipts, and recovery are byte-comparable in kind to a request-initiated row, with the retained literal appearing exactly once.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Predeclared refusals and faults: a signal from an unadmitted source, which must produce nothing and leave no partial row; a signal arriving under an expired or revoked credential lease; a signal whose declared tool binding does not cover the endpoint it came from; a duplicate signal, which must not produce a second work row; a work row created with an unresolvable subject or proof reference; an escalation attempted with no authority; a signal admitted while the daemon is unavailable, which must recover or refuse without inventing a row; a lane that produces a work row carrying weaker authority evidence than the request-initiated lane, which must fail closed rather than ship an asymmetric spine.
The baseline is that the wedge is contract-complete with zero wired sources, so every one of these branches is unexercised today.

code_anchors.evidence_scope: the declared-tools and credential-lease contract the single wired source must bind through; presence is not proof of this work item

remaining_nonclaims: One admitted signal is not continuous operation, is not coverage of the maintained product, and is not evidence that any second source would behave the same way.
Convergence on the same spine is proven for the branches exercised here and for no others.
This record closes no stage and publishes no claim. The rung this lane is required for is closed by its own aggregate, not by this cut.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop if the lane can only be made to work by giving a product signal a weaker authority, receipt, or recovery path than a request-initiated activation. Two entry modes converging on one spine is the whole claim; a second, softer spine for machine-initiated work is the failure this record exists to prevent, and a named gap is the honest outcome.
exit_criteria: One wired source, one admitted signal, one typed work row on the shared spine, the escalation edge exercised in both directions, every predeclared refusal firing by name, and the retained literal appearing exactly once.
